title: Inventory
description: An inventory defines a collection of hosts and groups that automation jobs target for execution.

id.description: The unique identifier of the inventory.

organization.description: The ID of the organization this inventory belongs to.

host_count.description: The total number of hosts in this inventory.

total_groups.description: The total number of groups in this inventory.

has_inventory_sources.description: Whether this inventory has dynamic sources.

modified.description: When the inventory was last modified.
